shared_elements: standing human figure(s) in elaborate costume
circular disc/rosette ornament at waist or chest
bilateral symmetry about a central vertical axis
dense decorative infill of costume elements
figure holding objects in hands at chest level
justification: Both depict richly costumed human figures with elaborate headdresses, pendant regalia and a prominent circular disc ornament at the waist/chest, arranged with strong bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis and with hands held before the body holding objects. However, A shows two profile-faced dancing figures flanking a central patterned band on a rounded field with flat outlined color areas, while B shows a single frontal figure on a tall vertical shaft with continuous relief-like, densely modelled ornament and mask motifs above and below, so the compositional format and rendering conventions differ markedly.
